overview_description.description:
DeepScribe is an AI-powered medical scribe platform that automates medical note taking for clinicians. DeepScribe uses AI, ML, and NLP to capture and transcribe natural clinical conversations in real time, extract relevant medical information, then classify it into a complete medical note. By combining AI with rules-based NLP and three speech recognition engines, DeepScribe is able to provide a fully automated, ambient solution for clinicians burdened by medical documentation.

With an easy-to-use mobile app and robust integrations with many popular EHR vendors, DeepScribe reimagines how documentation is captured and transforms how clinicians are able to deliver care.

product.name: DeepScribe Ambient Operating System
product.description: A cloud-based healthcare AI platform that automates clinical documentation, pre-visit preparation, coding, and point-of-care workflows for specialty practices.

product.name: AI Medical Scribe
product.description: An ambient AI medical scribe that captures clinician-patient conversations and converts them into specialty-specific clinical notes for review and synchronization with an EHR.

product.name: SmartPrep
product.description: A pre-visit intelligence tool that synthesizes relevant patient-chart information into a visit-ready summary for clinicians.

product.name: AI Coding
product.description: An AI coding solution that provides real-time support and automated recommendations for E/M, ICD-10, and HCC coding based on clinical documentation.

product.name: Customization Studio
product.description: A note-configuration tool that lets healthcare organizations and providers tailor AI-generated clinical notes to their specialties, templates, phrasing, and workflow preferences.

product.name: DeepScribe EHR Integrations
product.description: Bi-directional integrations that embed DeepScribe into supported electronic health records and synchronize patient context, notes, and workflow data.
